title: Why you put it off
topic: The psychology of why we procrastinate
hook: Your report is due in nine hours.

cast.description: a student with a report due at nine in the morning

scenes.narration: Your report is due in nine hours. So why are you watching videos?
You're not lazy. You open the document, it feels heavy, and your thumb finds the phone again.
Every scroll buys a little relief. And every minute, the guilt gets louder.
Psychologists call this present bias. A small reward right now outweighs a bigger one later.

scenes.setting: concept: the scale in the brain

scenes.narration: Here's the part nobody tells you. You're not avoiding the work. You're avoiding how the work feels.
So make the first step too small to feel bad. Open the file. Write one messy sentence. Two minutes later, you're still typing.
Starting was the hard part, and you already did it. You never needed more motivation. Just a smaller first step.
